title: WCAG Level AAA
about: The Editor colours hues at 7:1 — WCAG's Level AAA floor for text, the one for people who find 4.5:1 tiring — against every editor ground the app ships, light and dark. Asked for beside the fix to the light palettes on 2026-09-09: 4.5:1 is Level AA, 7:1 is Level AAA, and a palette that promises it in its file is held to it by the test that measures every scheme. It follows the editor's ground as Editor colours does, so it is a choice of palette rather than a theme of its own. What it costs is range: on a light ground the bright half sits close to the normal half, since bright cannot mean lighter and still clear the floor.
